description: This file contains the implementation of the PasswordStrengthService class, which provides functionalities for password policy enforcement, validation, and enforcement request logging within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for checking password strength, generating reset codes, validating reset requests, and managing enforced password changes.

classes.name: PasswordStrengthService
classes.description: A service class responsible for enforcing password policies, validating password strength, generating enforce password reset requests, and managing reset code validation within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getEnforcePasswordDao
methods.description: Returns the instance of EnforcePasswordDao, creating it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: getMinLength
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum password length from configuration settings.

methods.name: getMaxLength
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum password length from configuration settings.

methods.name: getMinNoOfLowercaseLetters
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum number of lowercase letters required in a password.

methods.name: getMinNoOfUppercaseLetters
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum number of uppercase letters required in a password.

methods.name: getMinNoOfNumbers
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum number of digits required in a password.

methods.name: getMinNoOfSpecialCharacters
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum number of special characters required in a password.

methods.name: getIsSpacesAllowed
methods.description: Checks whether spaces are permitted in passwords.

methods.name: getDefaultPasswordStrength
methods.description: Retrieves the default password strength policy setting.

methods.name: checkMinPasswordLength
methods.description: Checks if the password meets the minimum length requirement.

methods.name: checkMaxPasswordLength
methods.description: Checks if the password exceeds the maximum length requirement.

methods.name: checkMinLowercaseLetters
methods.description: Checks if the password contains at least the minimum number of lowercase letters.

methods.name: checkMinUppercaseLetters
methods.description: Checks if the password contains at least the minimum number of uppercase letters.

methods.name: checkMinNumbersInPassword
methods.description: Checks if the password contains at least the minimum number of digits.

methods.name: checkMinSpecialCharacters
methods.description: Checks if the password contains at least the minimum number of special characters.

methods.name: checkSpacesInPassword
methods.description: Checks if spaces are present in the password when not allowed.

methods.name: checkRequiredDefaultPasswordStrength
methods.description: Checks if the default password strength requirement is met.

methods.name: checkPasswordPolicies
methods.description: Validates the password against all policies and returns relevant messages.

methods.name: isValidPassword
methods.description: Determines if the password complies with all policies and requirements.

methods.name: generateEnforcePasswordResetCode
methods.description: Generates a secure reset code for password enforcement requests.

methods.name: logPasswordEnforceRequest
methods.description: Creates and logs a password enforcement request, returning the reset code.

methods.name: validateUrl
methods.description: Validates the reset code URL, checking for expiration and validity.

methods.name: isResetCodeTimeOut
methods.description: Checks if the reset code has expired based on timeout policy.

methods.name: getUserNameByResetCode
methods.description: Retrieves the username associated with a given reset code.

methods.name: saveEnforcedPassword
methods.description: Saves the new enforced password for a user and updates the database accordingly, handling transaction management.

methods.name: validateUser
methods.description: Validates that the user exists and is not terminated.
